note: Flat, not blue - this is the LOW CONTRAST sibling of the existing cold preset, which is contrast 1.10 and leans hard blue. Here contrast drops below 1 and gamma lifts slightly so the image loses its blacks, which is what overcast light actually does. Only a hint of blue in shadows. Reach for cold when you want chill, this when you want dreary.
